pillar_reactions.evidence: He engaged practically and about safety. During the pillar his only response was 'Yeah', but at the close he came back with the operational questions: 'So the first month, am I going to be using kettlebells?', 'Will you guys provide the kettlebells, or is that an additional fee?', and 'What weight would I start at?' — answered with a vendor list and roughly 8 kg. His substantive concern had already been stated at the trust gauge: 'my hesitation is, will I be able to do it with my little injuries here and there?' The mobility half of the pillar drew no reaction at all, which is notable for a man whose limitation is joint pain rather than capacity.

The most engaged pillar reaction in the batch — he interrupted to contribute before the rep could finish. 'Before you go on, I do fast 22 hours' and then, unprompted, the carnivore-leaning diet, two pounds of meat a day, the dairy where 'the cow doesn't even know it's missing', the label-scanning app, and a week-old switch to Ezekiel tortillas. He is already further into this pillar than the programme assumes. Worth flagging that the rep's contribution was to endorse and escalate — 'As you enter your sixties, fasting is huge when it comes to vitality. It's the biggest correlator between longevity' — rather than to question whether 22-hour fasting suits a 58-year-old recovering from repeated soft-tissue injury.

'Yeah, totally' during delivery, then unprompted: 'The accountability, like I said before, I don't think I've ever been as motivated as I am now.' He immediately extended it into his own frame, describing the one-to-one session booked with his priest the next day — 'when I told you I'm doing this physically and spiritually, I'm dead serious. As the quote goes, mind, body, and soul.' He also validated the mechanism from experience, describing how CrossFit called him when he missed a class. This is the pillar he wanted and the one he had already proven works on him.

anchors.raw: we've always stuck to the basic rules of like, hey, we said it's limit of anything over a thousand dollars. We need to talk about it before.
anchors.note: The most actionable anchor in the batch — a hard, explicit, quantified household governance rule with a number attached, disclosed voluntarily. It sits underneath every tier including the $1,200 trial the rep proposed as the solution to it. Any offer to this household either clears $1,000 or requires a joint conversation; there is no third option, and the trial does not clear it.

anchors.raw: they did pretty much that when I was doing CrossFit. They developed a meal plan for me, I followed the meal plan, I went in, did their exercises, and then the accountability was there, because if I don't go to class, they're going to call me and say, where are you at?
anchors.note: A local gym-priced competitor that delivered all three pillars in substance — programming, nutrition and chase-up accountability — and produced weight loss. It failed only on load management: 'it was tearing up my body. I just could not keep up.' That is both the objection and the opening, because load management is exactly what the film-and-review loop claims to fix, and the rep did not make that connection.

anchors.raw: we are also in the process of buying a house... We're hoping to do that this year. So things are going into play. So, you know, that's going to take a little bit of that portion.
anchors.note: A live, time-bound, large competing use of the same money, disclosed twice. Combined with a history of serious debt now cleared through a structured programme, this is a household with an active financial discipline system, which is the strongest possible form of price resistance because it is principled rather than circumstantial.

anchors.raw: The last few months, I started following Trevor, right? I would try some of his movements, and then I'd be pretty good.
anchors.note: He arrived already attempting the programme's movements from free content, which is why his need score was a 10. It also carries the sting that the most recent injury came from doing exactly that: 'Maybe I wanted the results faster than what it should be. I went up in weight... and then I hurt my sciatic nerve.' Trevor's content both created the demand and, unsupervised, caused the injury.

anchors.raw: I don't know if you're familiar with Mount Whitney... It's at 15,505 elevation, and I was able to do that last year... I'm 175 now. I was well over 200 pounds.
anchors.note: Twenty-five pounds lost since September, a 14,505 ft summit, seven miles of hiking a week and 22-hour daily fasting sustained since February. This is a prospect who does what he says, and his wife has told him 'I've never seen you be this consistent.' The strongest supportive evidence available and it was never used to justify the larger tiers.

unmet_demand.want: Training that will not trigger the sciatic nerve, the tennis elbow, the right shoulder or the right hip
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Four active injury sites and a fifteen-year pattern were laid out in detail, and the answer was the baseline audit plus an assurance that 'any pains that you're experiencing are naturally going to be subsided.' No clinician was suggested, none of the four sites was mapped against the movement library, and the prospect stated a hard exclusion — no burpees — that was never acknowledged. Whether this programme can be delivered inside his current constraints is unknown. FLAGGED FOR A HUMAN.

unmet_demand.want: Load progression slow enough that he cannot injure himself by pushing too hard
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is his actual failure mode and he diagnosed it himself — 'Maybe I wanted the results faster than what it should be.' The weekly film-and-review loop is a form-correction mechanism, not a load-governance mechanism, and nothing was said about who decides when the weight goes up or what stops him from deciding it himself between check-ins, which is precisely what happened three weeks earlier.

unmet_demand.want: A way for his wife to see and understand what he is buying before he commits
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He needs to take this to a joint decision and has no material to take. The rep acknowledged the problem directly — 'I wish that I could share this recording to her, but I can't for company purposes' — and offered a $1,200 trial as the workaround. A one-page explainer or a spouse-inclusive intro call are the obvious answers and neither exists.

unmet_demand.want: A commitment under the $1,000 household threshold
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Every tier including the trial exceeds it. The in-house payment plans were mentioned in passing and never structured, and no monthly figure was ever put in front of a man who had just told the rep exactly what number he needs to stay under.

unmet_demand.want: Preparation for a specific dated goal — the Camino de Santiago, roughly 500 miles on foot, at retirement in three to four years
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is the one thing on his bucket list and he mentioned it in his first answer. Nothing was positioned against it — no discussion of what load-bearing walking readiness looks like, no timeline, no milestones. The programme was sold on golden years in general terms when a concrete, dated, emotionally loaded target was sitting on the table.

unmet_demand.want: Nutrition guidance appropriate to 22-hour daily fasting alongside injury recovery at 58
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He is already fasting harder than the programme would prescribe and eating roughly two pounds of meat in a single daily window. The rep endorsed and amplified this rather than examining whether protein distribution across one meal supports connective-tissue repair in a man who tears something every four months. No qualified view was offered.
